analyst.summary: Jubilant Ingrevia's specialty chemicals and CDMO-adjacent business just posted a strong quarter -- revenue up 25% and profit up 41% year-on-year, with management reiterating its full-year profit guidance. That said, this recovery follows two to three weak years, returns on capital are only middling (around 8-13%), and the stock already trades at a rich ~43 times earnings that assumes the improvement is durable across several years, not just one good quarter. We would use the current price to trim rather than add.
